harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created and validated a confined systemd service `inventory-worker` on node1 (RHEL 7.9, systemd 219), then completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol for that node.
actions_performed: Created dedicated unprivileged system user 'inventory' (no login shell) and directory /var/lib/inventory (mode 750, owned inventory:inventory)
Installed worker script /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh that loops forever appending heartbeat timestamps to /var/lib/inventory/inventory.log every 5s

Installed /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service running as User=inventory/Group=inventory with NoNewPrivileges=yes, ProtectSystem=full, ProtectHome=yes, PrivateTmp=yes, ReadOnlyDirectories=/var, ReadWriteDirectories=/var/lib/inventory (RHEL7/systemd-219 equivalents of NoNewPrivileges/ReadWritePaths), enabled and started it
Proved confinement empirically with matching oneshot test units: write outside /var/lib/inventory failed with 'Read-only file system'; write inside /var/lib/inventory succeeded
Confirmed NoNewPrivs:1 in /proc/<pid>/status for the live worker process, and that it runs as the unprivileged 'inventory' user
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, systemctl is-enabled/is-active, and log line count
Issued `shutdown -r now` on node1 so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection, then polled until exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed after reconnection, proving an actual restart occurred
Verified post-restart recovery: service auto-started (enabled+active) as the same confined user, NoNewPrivs:1 still set, log file continuing to grow with correct ownership/permissions

evidence.requirement: inventory-worker runs as a managed (systemd) service
evidence.summary: Unit file installed, daemon-reload, enable, restart; systemctl is-enabled=enabled, is-active=active, status shows running process tree

evidence.requirement: Service is confined to write only inside /var/lib/inventory and gains no new privileges
evidence.summary: Oneshot test unit with identical sandboxing directives failed to write to /var/lib/should-not-write.txt ('Read-only file system'); identical unit succeeded writing to /var/lib/inventory/write-test.txt; NoNewPrivs:1 confirmed on live worker PID

evidence.requirement: Worker is genuinely long-running and producing data
evidence.summary: inventory.log grows heartbeat lines every 5s; pre-restart line count captured as baseline (10 lines)
Captured pre-restart boot_id 809708f3-... plus service enabled/active and log state

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnection
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now issued in background with nohup/disown; connection closed by remote host confirming the reboot command was accepted

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id cfa03d2c-... differs from pre-restart 809708f3-...; first poll timed out (rebooting), second poll succeeded

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required service and data
evidence.summary: inventory-worker auto-started (enabled+active) as user inventory with NoNewPrivs:1; inventory.log line count increased from 10 to 14 and continues appending; directory ownership/permissions unchanged
